name: Rubia Clarus
source:
[b]Class: [/b] Martial Artist
[b]Personality: [/b] Energetic

A bright, honest, and endlessly energetic succubus who charges through life at full speed.

She was a little shy when she first met Instructor Glenn, but it didn't take long before she completely warmed up to him.

As the youngest daughter of a family of renowned martial artists, Rubia grew up surrounded by high expectations. Unlike her older sisters, who all relied on careful strategy and technique, she could never stop herself from acting on instinct.

No matter how many times she was scolded with, "Think before you move!", she always ended up solving problems the same way—with overwhelming force and whatever felt right in the moment.
She dreams of becoming smarter someday... but thinking things through has never been her strong suit.

She loves sweets, fluffy cushions and clothes... and, of course, Instructor Glenn's life essence.

[b]Hopeless Trait: [/b] [i]A Reckless, Pleasure-Loving Troublemaker[/i]
Rubia is the type to leap into battle before her brain has time to catch up, charging straight at the enemy without the slightest regard for her allies' strategy or positioning.
To make matters worse, she's so open and positive about anything related to sex that she'll casually blurt out embarrassing comments or suggest outrageous ideas without reading the room.

[b]Secret Memo:[/b] [i]Rubia grew up cheerful, straightforward, and full of life.
Unfortunately... "modesty" is one stat she never invested any points into.
She'll happily chat about intimate topics with anyone, and with a bright smile on her face, she's liable to suggest something completely outrageous.[/i]

[b][i]"Me! Me! Pick me! I don't mind doing it outside at all! Even if everyone sees us, it's no big deal! We're all friends here anyway♪"[/i]
